title: The Well Heard EVERY Word 🪣
description:
Our town well grants every wish word for word. Not what you meant. What you said.

Three years ago I wished I'd never lose my big brother. Now he can't get one block away from me, and he just got the job he's always wanted, across the country.

It's made up. A blocky story, built with code and Blender.
pin: Comment WELL if you'd still make the wish.
